notes.title: GET A FREE COPY!
notes.content:
WHAT'S THAT? I CAN GET THIS GAME FOR FREE?

Yes, that's right! For a limited time you can obtain a free Steam key, but... There's a catch. To qualify for a free key you'll need to follow these steps.

1. Be a content creator on youtube

2. Have at least 1000 subscribers

3. Contact nodzigames@gmail.com from the same email as the one listed on your about page of your youtube channel. The email must contain a link to your channel, and the subject must be similar to "GIMME SEGFAULT", or whatever you want to make it really :P

4. Receive a FREE copy!

5. Create a let's play / review within a month of receiving the key, else it will unfortunately be revoked :(

6. After creating your let's play / review, please send us a link to your video and all the let's plays / reviews will be advertised on the next announcement. It's a win-win!

Happy Segfaulting!
